Name: Revised George for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I thought George deserved a little bit of love, so I gave him a bit of a makeover!

This mod is meant to be used with Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]. Assets used are a mix of open permission ones from Poltergeister and my own, for the ones that had closed permissions or when I couldn't reach an author. This mod cleans George up a bit and gives him a shiny new wheelchair, along with a few outfits. Simply overwrite the portrait and character assets with the ones downloaded here.

Enjoy!
